notes.title: New location - SUBWAY
notes.notes:
[b]We are glad to present you a new location for our game - Subway[/b]

The Redemption once again sends prisoners on a deadly mission, where this time they have to challenge forces capable of wiping the entire civilization from the face of the earth

Delve into the secrets of the mysterious tomb discovered under the heart of the metropolis, find out what happened to the scientists of the "Redemption" and unravel the mystery of the ancient Calendar,

But remember the dangers that lurk in the gloomy tunnels of the station. The employees, struck by the curse, wander tirelessly in search of a victim, but more than they should be afraid of the cruel Guardian protecting the mythical tomb from outsiders

notes.title: NEW MAP: Psychiatric hospital
notes.notes:
‘Redemption’ has discovered yet another cursed location. It’s an abandoned mental hospital. It was secretly funded by an occult organization. They were conducting experiments to reanimate and control corpses. However, the hospital suffered a disaster several years ago. It was shut down by the authorities and isolated from the world

‘Prisoners, you were given a chance to redeem yourselves through righteous deed’
‘Solve the mystery of the mental hospital and stop the horror it harbours’
